examples.text: This kind of policy approach is called Extended（extend的过去分词形式） Producer Responsibility.
examples.translation: 这种政策方式叫作“生产者责任延伸制度”。
examples.speechText: This kind of policy approach is called Extended Producer Responsibility.

examples.text: The island where these rare birds nest has been declared a reservation.
examples.translation: 这些珍稀鸟类筑巢的岛屿已被划为保护区。
examples.speechText: The island where these rare birds nest has been declared a reservation.

examples.text: Rather than thinking negatively, you should stay positive.
examples.translation: 你应该保持积极，而不是消极地思考。
examples.speechText: Rather than thinking negatively, you should stay positive.

examples.text: He took her hand and felt the scar on her thumb, a legacy of an accident with a kitchen knife in the early days of their marriage.
examples.translation: 他握住她的手，摸到了她拇指上的伤疤。这道伤疤是他们婚姻初期一次厨房刀具意外留下的印记。
examples.speechText: He took her hand and felt the scar on her thumb, a legacy of an accident with a kitchen knife in the early days of their marriage.

examples.text: Also, employers want to make sure that candidates provide new viewpoints for the company.
examples.translation: 此外，雇主希望确保求职者能为公司带来新观点。
examples.speechText: Also, employers want to make sure that candidates provide new viewpoints for the company.

examples.text: This boy is quite intelligent but rather lazy in his study.
examples.translation: 这个男孩很聪明，但学习上相当懒惰。
examples.speechText: This boy is quite intelligent but rather lazy in his study.

examples.text: Continuing to play it well into his senior years is the best thing he has ever done.
examples.translation: 即使年事已高仍坚持打乒乓球（it指代前文乒乓球），是他一生中做过的最好的事。
examples.speechText: Continuing to play it well into his senior years is the best thing he has ever done.

examples.text: Lots of refilling stores have opened（open的过去分词形式） in recent years.
examples.translation: 近年来，许多提供续装服务的商店已经开业。
examples.speechText: Lots of refilling stores have opened in recent years.

examples.text: Werner Berger, an art collector, agrees（agree的第三人称单数形式） that collecting is linked to childhood.
examples.translation: 艺术收藏者Werner Berger也认为，收藏与童年经历有关。
examples.speechText: Werner Berger, an art collector, agrees that collecting is linked to childhood.

examples.text: You can usually get a healthy, cheap breakfast in a restaurant.
examples.translation: 你通常能在餐馆里吃到健康又便宜的早餐。
examples.speechText: You can usually get a healthy, cheap breakfast in a restaurant.

examples.text: A healthy self-relationship can help you create a positive self-image, which is vital for you to become the best version of yourself.
examples.translation: 与自己建立健康的关系，有助于形成积极的自我形象；这对成为最好的自己至关重要。
examples.speechText: A healthy self-relationship can help you create a positive self-image, which is vital for you to become the best version of yourself.

examples.text: People with income below the poverty line are considered poor.
examples.translation: 收入低于贫困线的人被视为贫困者。
examples.speechText: People with income below the poverty line are considered poor.

examples.text: Without these values（value的复数形式）, our jobs and our economy will bring us joyless riches.
examples.translation: 缺少这些价值观，我们的工作和经济只能带来没有快乐的财富。
examples.speechText: Without these values, our jobs and our economy will bring us joyless riches.

examples.text: Susan is always a shy girl and feels embarrassed in the presence of strangers.
examples.translation: Susan一直是个害羞的女孩，在陌生人面前会感到尴尬。
examples.speechText: Susan is always a shy girl and feels embarrassed in the presence of strangers.

examples.text: Every region has its own special food, which carries（carry的第三人称单数形式） the history and customs of the place.
examples.translation: 每个地区都有自己独特的食物，其中承载着当地的历史和风俗。
examples.speechText: Every region has its own special food, which carries the history and customs of the place.
